faq.question: What will I learn in this Google Ads course?
faq.answer: You will learn end-to-end paid search advertising and performance marketing using modern 2027-ready workflows. The curriculum covers search intent analysis, Keyword Planner research, Responsive Search Ads creation, Smart Bidding strategies (Target CPA, Target ROAS), Performance Max and Demand Gen AI campaigns, GA4 conversion tracking, Google Tag Manager setup, search query auditing, budget pacing, and executive Looker Studio performance reporting.

faq.question: Is this Google Ads course suitable for beginners?
faq.answer: Yes. The course starts from foundational search advertising concepts, user intent, and campaign economics before advancing into sophisticated bidding and AI workflows. All exercises use structured simulations, sandbox configurations, and realistic business briefs. You do not need prior marketing degrees, coding expertise, or an existing business.

faq.question: What are the course fees and duration?
faq.answer: The course duration is 8 Weeks (2 Months), comprising 64 guided learning and practical lab hours. The fee is INR 9,900 (+ applicable GST), following Nova Skills' Truth in Pricing policy with transparent institutional pricing and zero fake countdown discounts.

faq.question: Does the course cover Performance Max and Demand Gen?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 04 is dedicated to Google AI Advertising, covering Performance Max asset groups, audience signals, first-party data integration, Demand Gen campaigns, creative asset planning, and responsible AI-assisted copywriting using Gemini and ChatGPT.

faq.question: Will I learn conversion tracking and GA4?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 05 focuses specifically on conversion measurement. You will learn conversion tracking fundamentals, primary vs secondary conversion actions, Google Tag Manager container deployment, GA4 event linking with Google Ads, Enhanced Conversions, attribution fundamentals, and tracking verification diagnostics.

faq.question: Does the course include practical projects?
faq.answer: Yes. You will complete three comprehensive portfolio deliverables: (1) a full Google Search Lead Generation Campaign build sheet with negative keywords and ad copy, (2) a multimodal Google AI (Performance Max / Demand Gen) Campaign plan with audience signals, and (3) a Four-Week Campaign Optimization & Reporting Workbook with an executive Looker Studio dashboard.

faq.question: Will I receive an official Google certification?
faq.answer: The course includes preparation for applicable Google Ads Skillshop certifications, such as the Google Ads Search and Measurement certifications. Official Google certifications are awarded separately by Google after successful completion of the relevant Skillshop assessment. Nova Skills awards its accredited Google Ads Performance Specialist Certificate of Completion upon fulfilling all course practicals.

faq.question: What jobs can I explore after completing this course?
faq.answer: Graduates develop competencies aligned with roles such as Google Ads Specialist, Junior PPC Specialist, Paid Search Executive, Google Ads Campaign Executive, and Performance Marketing Executive (Google Ads Focus), as well as freelance paid search consulting and account management. Career outcomes depend on individual interview performance and project portfolio quality.
